description: Discovers, runs and debugs xUnit, NUnit, MSTest and TUnit tests on VSTest and Microsoft.Testing.Platform, with coverage from Coverlet.

enumDescriptions: Microsoft.Testing.Platform for projects that enable it, VSTest otherwise
Microsoft.Testing.Platform where the project supports it
testing.platform.description: The test platform for projects that support both.

testing.runSettingsFile.description: A .runsettings file for VSTest projects (relative to the solution folder). Empty: none.

testing.targetFramework.description: The target framework to test in multi-targeted projects (for example net10.0). Empty: every framework.

testing.architecture.description: The process architecture of VSTest test hosts.

testing.parallel.description: Run test projects in parallel (VSTest: MaxCpuCount).

testing.environment.description: Environment variables for test processes, as NAME=value.

testing.runAfterBuild.description: After a build, run the tests of the test projects it built.

testing.discoverAfterBuild.description: After a build, ask the test runners for the tests (theories, data rows and generated tests appear).

coverage.include.description: Coverlet include filters, such as [MyApp]* (empty: the solution's own non-test projects).
